External Communication

Rintangan dilaporkan

Notification that a physical hazard, such as a wreck, buoy, or floating object, has been observed in a navigable area, requiring mariners to exercise caution.

Quick answer: Notification that a physical hazard, such as a wreck, buoy, or floating object, has been observed in a navigable area, requiring mariners to exercise caution.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Rintangan dilaporkan?

In this glossary, Rintangan dilaporkan refers to: Notification that a physical hazard, such as a wreck, buoy, or floating object, has been observed in a navigable area, requiring mariners to exercise caution.

How is Rintangan dilaporkan used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Rintangan dilaporkan di utara buoy fairway Bravo. Semua kapal harap waspada dan laporkan jika ada penampakan lain ke VTS."

Why does Rintangan dilaporkan matter in maritime?

Rintangan dilaporkan matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Rintangan dilaporkan?

Rintangan dilaporkan is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Rintangan dilaporkan belong to?

In this glossary, Rintangan dilaporkan is grouped under External Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Notification that a physical hazard, such as a wreck, buoy, or floating object, has been observed in a navigable area, requiring mariners to exercise caution.

Operational example

Obstruction reported north of fairway buoy Bravo. All vessels exercise caution and report any further sightings to VTS.

Localized term

Rintangan dilaporkan

Localized example

Rintangan dilaporkan di utara buoy fairway Bravo. Semua kapal harap waspada dan laporkan jika ada penampakan lain ke VTS.
